pairs.subject: proactive-nudges
pairs.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_glyph/useRecipeStarters.ts:5 The only suggestion-shaped behaviour in the Glyph card is recipe matching against the intent the user is typing, so the user has already opened the channel; nothing here starts contact on its own. Searching src/features/agents/sub_glyph for nudge, proactive, quietHours/quiet_hours and attentionBudget/attention_budget found 0 files. Nudges in the repo live elsewhere (companion, fleet, whatsNew).

techniques.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_glyph/useRecipeStarters.ts:33 The matcher fires 300ms after the user stops typing (a keystroke debounce). It is not a background evaluator that watches state and decides to reach out.

src/features/agents/sub_glyph/contactSheet/cinema/useCinemaRecipes.ts:12 Impression, accept and dismiss telemetry exists, but it measures a suggestion the user asked for while composing, not a machine-initiated nudge. It is close in spirit, but the subject's precondition does not hold.
